lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye
couplets.en: Little by little, you became the very stuff of my life.

lines: Pehle jaan, phir jaan-e-jaan, phir jaan-e-jaanaan ho gaye
couplets.en: First my life, then my soul, then dearer still.

lines: Din-ba-din badhti gayin us husn ki raanaaiyaan
couplets.en: With each passing day, that beauty found another grace.

lines: Pehle gul, phir gul-badan, phir gul-ba-daamaan ho gaye
couplets.en: First a rose, then a body like a rose, then roses gathered in your hem.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye
couplets.en: Little by little, you became the very stuff of my life.

lines: Aap to nazdeek se nazdeek-tar aate gaye
couplets.en: You came nearer, and nearer still.

lines: Pehle dil, phir dil-ruba, phir dil ke mehmaan ho gaye
couplets.en: First my heart, then its captor, then the guest it made room for.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye
couplets.en: Little by little, you became the very stuff of my life.

couplets.en: First my life, then my soul, then dearer still.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye
couplets.en: Little by little, you became the very stuff of my life.

lines: Pyaar jab had se badha, saare takalluf mit gaye
couplets.en: As love outgrew its bounds, all reserve fell away.

lines: Aap se phir tum hue, phir tu ka unwaan ho gaye
couplets.en: Aap softened into tum, and at last into the intimate tu.
